dct_title_s: Roads of Congo, The Democratic Republic of the
dct_description_sm: Road network across the region tagged `highway=*`: motorways, residential streets, service roads, footways, and trails. Useful for routing, accessibility analysis, and evacuation planning. Coverage reflects where volunteer mappers have been active. Urban areas are usually well represented, remote areas may be sparse. Cross-check critical decisions with local field knowledge. - Source: [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org), a free, collaborative world map - Tags: [highway](https://wiki.openstreetmap.org/wiki/Key:highway) - Part of the [exports grid on HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hot/) by [HOT](https://www.hotosm.org/)
